industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers
name: Izdemir Enerji Elektrik Uretim A.S.
summary: IZDEMIR Enerji Elektrik Uretim A.S. produces and sells electricity through coal. It is also involved in the iron-steel and port and power plant, solar energy plant businesses. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is headquartered in Izmir, Turkey. IZDEMIR Enerji Elektrik Uretim A.S. is a subsidiary of Izmir Demir Çelik Sanayi Anonim Sirketi.
